name: Key West Kitten
summary: Although it is named for the Florida Keys, other locations, particularly Coney Island and Myrtle Beach, serve as inspiration for the aesthetic.
description: Although it is named for the Florida Keys, other locations, particularly Coney Island and Myrtle Beach, serve as inspiration for the aesthetic. Like many other online aesthetics, Key West Kitten has become subject to mass-tagging, meaning that vaguely-related or unrelated images will often appear in search results for it. Likewise, it is sometimes used interchangeably with the names of other, related aesthetics, particularly Coconut Girl and Tropicalcore .
culturalContext: Key West Kitten was first coined by blogger/influencer Alida Simone, who gained prominence within the Nymphet, Coquette, and Trailer Park Princess communities in around 2016 under the username @babydarkoangel. It is unknown when exactly the aesthetic originated, as some of its most popular images are from the 2000s or even earlier, but by the time the name Key West Kitten was (most likely) coined in 2017, it was quite prevalent on Pinterest and Tumblr. Before the name was coined, bloggers would often simply tag their photos with Lizzy Grant-related hashtags such as #wayamaya and #mermaid motel. Regarding the aesthetic, Simone herself has stated that Key West Kitten wasn't an aesthetic for her, and was just her and her life, and that the name Key West Kitten was what her mother would sometimes call her due to the fact that the Florida Keys are where she and Simone's father first fell in…
